metadata.title: fix(security): harden Helm chart values.yaml with secure production defaults
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Align `charts/mcp-stack/values.yaml` with `mcpgateway/config.py` secure defaults and tighten for production deployments
- Add `charts/mcp-stack/values-minikube.yaml` as a local development overlay for minikube testing
- Net reduction of ~130 lines by collapsing sub-settings behind disabled master switches

## Key Changes

### Security Hardening (config.py alignment)
- `ENVIRONMENT`: `development` → `production`
- `PASSWORD_REQUIRE_UPPERCASE/LOWERCASE/SPECIAL`: `false` → `true` (match config.py)
- `REQUIRE_STRONG_SECRETS`: `false` → `true`
- `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE`: `true` → `false`
- `MCPGATEWAY_GRPC_REFLECTION_ENABLED`: `true` → `false` (exposes service definitions)
- `APP_DOMAIN` / `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`: `http://localhost` → `https://gateway.local`
- `pullPolicy`: `Always` → `IfNotPresent` (production should pin tags)

### Missing Security Flags Added
- `ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ADMIN: "false"` — explicit deny of dangerous dev-only flag
- `TRUST_PROXY_AUTH_DANGEROUSLY: "false"` — explicit deny
- `PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_ENABLED: "false"` — no self-registration
- `MCPGATEWAY_STDIO_TRANSPORT_ENABLED: "false"` — no process execution
- `PLUGINS_CAN_OVERRIDE_RBAC: "false"` — RBAC bypass denied
- `FAILED_LOGIN_MIN_RESPONSE_MS: "250"` — timing side-channel mitigation
- `TOKEN_USAGE_LOGGING_ENABLED: "true"` — SOC2 compliance
- `SSRF_BLOCKED_NETWORKS` / `SSRF_BLOCKED_HOSTS` — explicit cloud metadata blocklists

### Features Disabled by Default
- LLM Chat (`LLMCHAT_ENABLED: "false"`) + LLM settings removed
- Roots (`DEFAULT_ROOTS/ALLOWED_ROOTS: "[]"`, hidden from UI)
- gRPC (already false, sub-settings collapsed)
- OTEL (`OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER: "none"`, sub-settings commented)

### Collapsed Disabled Features (sub-settings commented out)
Plugins (17 settings), SSO providers (~55 settings), SMTP (9), Session Pool (13), Session Affinity (3), Performance Monitoring (7), Security Logging (4), External Log Sinks (5), Ed25519 (4), Header Passthrough (2), File Logging (6), Well-Known security.txt (2), Query Param Auth (1)

### Removed Unnecessary Settings
`DB_DRIVER` (chart uses PostgreSQL), `DB_SQLITE_BUSY_TIMEOUT`, `DB_QUERY_LOG_*` (7 dev settings), `MASKED_AUTH_VALUE`, `PLUGINS_CLI_*`, `TEMPLATES_DIR`/`STATIC_DIR`, `VALIDATION_*_PATTERN` (18 regex patterns — config.py defaults are correct), `GATEWAY_MODEL`/`GATEWAY_TEMPERATURE`

### New File
`charts/mcp-stack/values-minikube.yaml` — local dev overlay with `pullPolicy: Never`, relaxed SSRF for in-cluster, dev credentials, single replica, smaller resource limits

## Tested
- Deployed to minikube with `helm upgrade --install` (layered values)
- All pods healthy, no startup errors
- curl smoke tests: health, auth enforcement (401 on all endpoints), CORS, security headers, disabled features (404), token validation, gateway registration, tool discovery + invocation
- Playwright: 20 passed, 15 skipped across auth, API endpoints, admin UI, gateways, agents, tools test suites

commits.message:
fix(security): harden Helm chart values.yaml with secure production defaults

Align values.yaml with config.py secure defaults and tighten for production:

- Set ENVIRONMENT=production, PASSWORD_REQUIRE_UPPERCASE/LOWERCASE/SPECIAL=true,
  REQUIRE_STRONG_SECRETS=true to match config.py defaults
- Add missing security flags: ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ADMIN, TRUST_PROXY_AUTH_DANGEROUSLY,
  PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_ENABLED, PLUGINS_CAN_OVERRIDE_RBAC, MCPGATEWAY_STDIO_TRANSPORT_ENABLED
- Add SSRF_BLOCKED_NETWORKS/HOSTS, TOKEN_USAGE_LOGGING_ENABLED, FAILED_LOGIN_MIN_RESPONSE_MS
- Disable features not needed by default: LLM Chat, gRPC, roots, OTEL exporters
- Collapse sub-settings behind disabled master switches (plugins, SSO providers,
  SMTP, session pool, performance monitoring, security logging, external log sinks)
- Remove unnecessary settings (DB_DRIVER, DB_SQLITE_BUSY_TIMEOUT, DB_QUERY_LOG_*,
  MASKED_AUTH_VALUE, PLUGINS_CLI_*, validation regex patterns, LLM settings)
- Set pullPolicy=IfNotPresent, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=none, gRPC reflection=false
- Add values-minikube.yaml for local development overlay

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
